title: zkFil
tagline: zkFil, utilizing Zero Knowledge Proofs, fortifies service provider identities for any DataDAO.
description:
In the highly competitive landscape of storage services, providers strive to safeguard their unique capabilities from prying competitors while ensuring users receive essential information. Introducing zkFil, a revolutionary contract empowering storage providers to craft an exclusive identity for their services. This distinctive identity can be seamlessly listed on marketplaces, enabling providers to participate in strategic bidding.

zkFil serves as a pivotal tool for DataDAOs and Data Marketplaces within the FVM ecosystem. By enabling providers to selectively reveal information, it strikes a delicate balance between maintaining confidentiality among competitors and offering users the necessary insights. Elevate your storage services in the FVM marketplace with zkFil, a game-changer in the world of decentralized data solutions.
how_its_made: The circuits required for generating zero knowledge proofs were written in Circom and the corresponding verification contract and NFT minting and marketplace contract were written in solidity and deployed on FEVM. The contracts were deployed using Remix IDE and Metamask was used for interacting with those contracts and carrying out the transactions.
